tasks.description: Converts HTML pages to Markdown, keeping headings, lists, links, emphasis and tables. Use when asked to convert a folder of HTML pages to Markdown.
tasks.intent: Convert HTML pages to a single Markdown file.

tasks.description: Builds an index of documents with format, size, line count, title and table shape. Use when asked for an index or inventory of the documents in a folder.
tasks.intent: Index documents by format, size, line count and title.

tasks.description: Extracts tables from HTML pages and CSV files as Markdown tables with counts. Use when asked to extract the tables from a folder of documents.
tasks.intent: Extract HTML and CSV tables as Markdown tables.
